# Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet

by VolcaLast Updated: October 1, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Last Epoch has various Boss Encounters with exclusive loot drop pools. This means that the main source for the following items is killing these Bosses. Some Boss drops also have alternative methods of obtaining them. Use this Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet to figure out what each Boss drops, and at which difficulty you should run your Bosses to maximize the odds to obtain a certain item.

## Timeline Bosses & Harbingers

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Timeline Bosses and Harbingers have a pool of exclusive items that can drop. Many of them can only drop in Empowered Monolith. Higher Corruption improves the drop rate, except for drops with a 50% chance, such as Woven Flesh.

In addition to their boss-specific loot, all Timeline Bosses can drop the following items:

- Collapsing Horizon
- Dungeon Keys

In addition to their boss-specific loot, all Harbingers can drop the following items:

- Harbinger Eye
- Harbinger's Needle
- The Fading Brink
- Temporal Keystone

Monolith Boss Guides

Find more information on all Timeline Bosses and Harbingers in the Monolith Page.

## Shade of Orobyss

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Shade of Orobyss can show up in any Timeline in Echo of a World. You can also find it in Confluence of Oblivion, where its items have a higher drop chance.

The following items can drop at any Corruption:

- Siphon of Anguish
- Stymied Fate

The following items have a minimum Corruption they can drop at. Drop chance increases with Corruption and distance from the center of the web. Drops in Confluence of Oblivion are not affected by distance.

- Apathy's Maw 50+ Corruption
- Shattered Chains 120+ Corruption
- Omnis 200+ Corruption

## Dungeon Bosses

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Dungeons require a Dungeon Key to enter, and contain Bosses with exclusive loot. These items can also be obtained in the Monolith with the Weaver Tree node Warden's Echo, which grants a chance to spawn Dungeon-specific enemies.

The Mountain Beneath - Lightless Arbor Key

- Peak of the Mountain
- Foot of the Mountain
- Face of the Mountain
- Core of the Mountain

Cremorus - Soulfire Bastion Key

- Ashes of Mortality
- Lich's Envy
- Immolator's Oblation
- Pyre of Affliction

Chronomancer Julra - Temporal Sanctum Key

- Julra's Stardial
- Somnia
- Julra's Obsession
- Vessel of Strife

## Aberroth & Uber Aberroth

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Fight Aberroth by using a Harbinger Eye at the Altar of Oblivion in Shattered Road.

Aberroth has its own boss-specific drops, and it can also drop any item from the Harbingers.

Uber Aberroth in Threshold of Eternity has additional exclusive item drops.

Aberroth

- Nihilis 14.29%
- Seed of Ekkidrasil 38.1%
- Null Portent 47.62%
- Threshold of Eternity 100%

Uber Aberroth

- Immortal Vise 80%
- Shattered Worlds 20%

Harbingers

- Aberroth's Command
- Bane of Winter
- Black Blade of Chaos
- Celestial Doom
- Event Horizon
- Flames of Midnight
- Phase Point
- The Inevitable
- World Splitter
- Wall of Nothing
- Harbinger's Needle

## Vision of the Observer

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Vision of the Observer in Fractured Prison can drop the following items:

- Oculus of Ruin 100%
- Exulis 10%
- Drops as Corrupted Legendary with 1 random regular Affix and 2 of the following Corrupted Affixes:
- Strength converted to Brutality
- Intelligence converted to Madness
- Dexterity converted to Guile
- Attunement converted to Apathy
- Vitality converted to Rampancy

- In addition to its exclusive loot, it also drops multiple Omen Idols.

## Morditas

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Rage of Morditas encounters in the Monolith of Fate contribute to an overall meta progression which ends with a fight against Morditas. To reach Morditas you have to first unlock the two preceding Woven Echoes by slaying enemies in Rage of Morditas encounters. The boss has two different versions, with different loot tables.

Morditas in Circle of Frozen Blood (Unlocked after 4000 Rage of Morditas kills)

- Frostborn Solitude 80%
- Heorot's Repose 20%
- Withstand the Elements 50%
- Demigod's Ascendance 100%

Pinnacle Morditas in Demigod's Ascendance

- Morditas' Vengeance 20%
- Vestige of Imprisonment 80%
- Unsated Rage 50%

## Woven Echo Bosses

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Certain Woven Echoes have boss exclusive item drops:

- The Grand Brewery: Brewmaster's Buckle
- Tomb of Vessels: Countenance of Majasa
- The Seeker's Summit: Orian's Descent
- Antipode Rift: Dominance of the Tundra
- Heart of the Hive: Soul of the Mountain
- Overgrown Graveyard: Unearthed Memories

The following items can drop from the Bosses of Tombs of the Erased and Lostwood Folly:

- Fateweaver Clotho: Clotho's Needle
- Fateweaver Atropos: Scissor of Atropos
- Fateweaver Lachesis: Blight of Lachesis

Inheritance of the Erased drops from Woven Firstborn in Cemetery of the Erased and Cenotaph of Worlds.

## Exiled Mages

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet

- Merophage
- The Cuckoo

## Arena Champions

Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
Arena Champions have exclusive item drops. While you can find these Bosses in Arena of Champions, farming Champions' Colosseum is much more efficient.
